fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The case supplies a positive, dated observation of announced consideration relative to contemporaneous forecasts: 2.831492x revenue and 13.398693x adjusted proforma EBITDA. It does not supply complete economic enterprise value or a transferable borrower valuation. N=1 supports individual-case context only: no statistics, range, fair value, ranking or outlier conclusion. The historical observation is stale for current market use, not stale relative to its own announcement date.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Credit interpretation (analyst judgement): forecast or diligence adjustments failing to convert into recurring cash earnings would first weaken operating cash generation, then delay debt repayment and raise leverage/refinancing pressure. Monitor the EBITDA bridge, realized cash conversion and actual acquisition perimeter before assigning valuation support. Source: announcement p. 2, L143–145 and p. 1, L92–112.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Financing and approval delays could extend execution uncertainty; if bridge funding were drawn and not replaced before its 364-day maturity, refinancing needs would become a liquidity constraint. Commitments and absence of a merger financing condition are a counterweight, not proof of funding or favorable debt economics. Monitor approvals, final funding mix, pricing, maturities and actual drawings (agreement-summary p. 1, L97–124).

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The strongest supported countercase is HEICO's expectation of post-acquisition net debt/EBITDA below 3x and return to historical levels in roughly 12–18 months, excluding future acquisitions/capital deployment, alongside complementary offerings and unquantified synergies (announcement p. 1, L33–44). It would win if sustained earnings and cash generation delivered that deleveraging. Until evidenced, it lowers conviction in a severe downside but cannot establish actual leverage, Wencor standalone debt capacity or a synergy-adjusted multiple. Customer types support sector relevance, not assumptions about concentration, contract duration, pricing power or recurring revenue.

fields.name: Quote

Both denominators are strictly positive; ratios are multiples, not percentages.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Tax sensitivity: USD millions, same announced price and forecast EBITDA; estimated benefit through FY2038 from `announcement` p. 1, L30–32: sum(2050,-75)=1975; ratio(1975,153)=12.908496732026143790849673202614379085. Rounded to one decimal this reconciles the issuer's approximately 12.9x. This is subtraction of the stated estimate, not independently assessed NPV, cash at closing or a synergy adjustment. Timing and realization remain uncertain.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Complete economic EV would require a consistent bridge: transaction equity value + debt + minority interests + preferred equity − cash − available liquid short-term investments, with agreement adjustments reconciled and double counting avoided. Those components and the precise consideration-to-EV bridge are Not supplied; complete economic EV is Not calculable. Escrow is not incremental and committed financing is not acquired debt or actual borrowing.
